scope: Proposals for root integration only; does not mutate the shared discovery ledger or programme.

status_definitions.computed_certificate: Exact concrete output retained with a replayable certificate.
status_definitions.derived_from_certified_data: A stated proof uses specified exact finite data.
status_definitions.literature_result: A cited primary source already establishes the result.
status_definitions.candidate_pending_certificate: Plausible or reported result awaiting its stated proof and receipt.
status_definitions.research_target: A proposed task with explicit acceptance criteria; not claimed solved or globally novel.

discoveries.title: An injective differential translation tower of arc-kernel modules

claim.nonzero_generator: F_Q has ordinary degree3 and E(F_Q)=0
claim.all_order_left_inverse: E^r D^r F_Q=3^r*r!*F_Q for all r>=0

discoveries.claim_boundary: This is an all-weight lower bound obtained from an injective translation operator, not a complete higher-weight kernel character or generation theorem. E descends to the old arc algebra; only D is claimed to preserve the arc-map kernel.
discoveries.priority_claim: No worldwide novelty claim is made.

discoveries.title: An explicit all-order family of differential annihilator syzygies

claim.reason: F_Q lies in S^2(g[0])*g[1] and all ordinary cubics vanish
claim.leibniz_family: sum_(j=0)^r binom(r,j)*j!*x^[j]*D^(r-j)F_Q=0 in the arc algebra

discoveries.claim_boundary: The displayed family follows by differentiating an exact ordinary annihilator. It is not asserted to generate every differential syzygy or the full higher arc kernel.
discoveries.priority_claim: No worldwide novelty claim is made.

discoveries.title: Exact finite E8-module characters of the level-one VOA through weight six

claim.method: dominant-chamber-folded exact Freudenthal recursion plus lattice/Fock weight multiplicities
claim.coefficients: nonnegative integral multiplicities; Weyl-dimension sum recovers each character coefficient

discoveries.claim_boundary: Finite-module decompositions are computed only in the declared weight range. The all-degree scalar character is known literature; this computation does not classify the arc ideal.
discoveries.priority_claim: No worldwide novelty claim is made.

discoveries.title: The complete length-three arc Hilbert sector

claim.sector: ordinary polynomial length3 in the old E8 arc algebra
claim.statement: rational Hilbert series and finite E8-character decomposition from exact polarization maps
claim.proof: S3 polynomial covariants and exact pair-diagonal image modules; pair-fixed lines reconstructed from sparse Lie polarization and independent Schur/tensor characters

discoveries.claim_boundary: This is a complete all-order Hilbert/finite-character theorem for ordinary polynomial length3. It does not classify the full arc algebra, higher-length sectors or the infinite differential kernel.
discoveries.priority_claim: No worldwide novelty claim is made.

discoveries.title: Formal full monodromy and the rational-parameter determinant obstruction

discoveries.claim_boundary: No numerical epsilon, parameterized Kolchin group, generic Picard–Vessiot group over C(hbar)(z), or Zariski-open set of all complex parameters is computed. Rational specializations require a separate proof.

discoveries.title: An exhaustive classical dynamical elliptic E8 tensor and its limits

claim.analytic_statement: all-nome meromorphic CDYBE reduced to classical Fay and derivative identities
claim.finite_implementation_replay: exact rational theta-product coefficients through p^2 in exhaustive mode
claim.degeneration: sequential p->0 trigonometric, then epsilon-scaled rational tensor

discoveries.claim_boundary: This implements an established classical all-type solution, with a full E8 tensor reduction. It does not construct a quantum R matrix, flat modular KZB realization, or KZ-to-KZB map. Exact finite nome coefficients do not provide analytic numerical tail bounds at a nonzero nome. The sparse entry, product and4,290-residual counts refer to that retained rational specialization; at permitted theta-numerator zeros individual entries may disappear.
discoveries.priority_claim: No worldwide novelty claim is made.

discoveries.title: A rank-eight charged affine carrier with exact heat and Ward normalization
discoveries.claim_boundary: Classical lattice/VOA and Jacobi theorems supply the all-order transformations. Finite charge and moment checks retain their explicit bound. Jacobi z uses exp(2*pi*i*z), whereas the elliptic tensor uses additive periods2*pi*i; compare via z_ell=2*pi*i*z_Jac and the Cartan metric coordinate map.
discoveries.priority_claim: No worldwide novelty claim is made.

discoveries.title: The exact degree-eight angular defect and its Lehmer boundary
discoveries.claim_boundary: The harmonic-theta and Lehmer equivalence are established mathematics integrated into the exact program. Complete tensor coefficients are replayed only through the declared shell range; finite nonzero defects do not prove Ramanujan tau nonvanishing for every n.
discoveries.priority_claim: No worldwide novelty claim is made.

discoveries.claim_boundary: The modular theorem is polynomial-valued in u, but computed coefficient arrays above angular degree8 are only the e1 specialization. No entire multivariate degree30 tensor or all-angular-degree implementation is claimed.

discoveries.priority_claim: No worldwide novelty claim is made.

discoveries.title: An explicit nonzero quartic arc class and exact invariant line

claim.sector: length4/Li2 at conformal weight6; x zero jet, y divided first jet
claim.metric: B(h_i,h_j)=Cartan_ij; B(e_alpha,e_minus_alpha)=1; symmetric tensors use averaged symmetrization

discoveries.claim_boundary: The full duality and nonzero self-pairing prove that F0 survives the arc quotient. Its individual VOA image and an affine null lift are not computed. Invariant counts alone do not locate the kernel singlet in Li degree2 or3. This standalone invariant calculation is included in the separate exact quartic classification AST-D048; do not count its line twice.
discoveries.priority_claim: No worldwide novelty claim is made.

discoveries.title: Exact quartic classification completes the weight-six arc-kernel finite character

claim.independent_grounding: actual adjoint weights, complete3875 weight support, Newton identities, fixed norm16/32 bounds and exact Freudenthal reconstruction
